title: Durable-state checkpoint clobbered newer backlog items (state/sync merge)
body: A state/sync merge (PR #135) overwrote newer backlog items with a stale snapshot (revisions/updated_at backward, history deleted, epics/delivery lost). Root cause + guards in the linked backlog item.

rcca.symptom: Newer backlog items reverted on develop by a state/sync merge (PR #135)
rcca.why1: core/state_checkpoint copied the whole durable tree from a stale runtime checkout
rcca.why2: It used _copy_durable + git add -A (whole-store overwrite), not a per-item reconcile
rcca.why3: Item files are SOURCE and had no version guard / merge driver (only derived files did)
rcca.why4: No gate detected a revision/updated_at regression (backlog-context only checks presence)
rcca.why5: The checkpoint was treated as a blanket snapshot, not a reconcile against the base
rcca.guard: pf-item newest-wins merge driver + backlog-monotonic precheck gate + checkpoint newest-wins reconcile
